overall_assessment: Strong on incident basics (al-Batsh killing, passports, Avitan firearms conviction, Abdul Azim 10y+6 strokes, ~50 officers). Materially weaker on over-generalisations: overclaims the passport pattern ('always'), understates the Aug 2025 parliamentary Mossad-recruitment allegation, and incorrectly says every conviction was for guns when July 2025 produced abduction convictions. Salvageable with tighter wording separating allegation from court proof.
